narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a recruitment advertisement for the company '簡訊設計' (Simple Info Design). It highlights various employee benefits—such as remote work from locations like Japan, flexible working hours, and an extra day of leave per month—through interviews with existing staff. The lighthearted and humorous tone, combined with the personal anecdotes of the founder, aims to present the company as a desirable and employee-centric workplace to attract potential job seekers.
